title: Comcast
desc: I build the Java pipelines and API imports that move data between internal systems, and I tune and watch the daily jobs that run over millions of records.
bullets: Build Java data-ingestion pipelines that move data between internal systems.
Automated an API import of another team's data into the reporting database, with retries for rate limits and other failures. Also wired an internal API into the streaming-service report graphs.
Built failure alerts over Slack, Teams and email, including an end-of-day alert when a report fails to publish. Moved the Slack alerts to OAuth, and made reports wait until their data imports finish.

Cut more than 6 hours from the total daily run by adding parallel processing to four or five job families, with parallel PL/SQL and CloverDX graphs. Fixed critical runtime failures in the streaming-service reports the same way.
Rewrote a slow query, added indexes and changed its joins, cutting that job's runtime by over 80%. Took a separate recurring job from four or five hours down to about one.
Upgraded CloverDX from 6.3.1 to 7.4.2 and updated the graphs and reports that depend on it.
Take user stories in Jira from development through deployment on Concourse CI/CD, working with product owners and the DevOps team.

Support about 15 recurring reports that run daily over hundreds of thousands to millions of records. Built two end to end and drove the design of about five more, with validation checks that catch bad data before release.
Write and maintain the Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures and migration scripts behind an internal fulfillment-accuracy system.
Review teammates' code, mentor new contractors on the team, and clean up legacy code when the workload is light.

title: Turn 14 Distribution
desc: Four years building the company's B2B e-commerce platform and warehouse management system in PHP, JavaScript and MySQL, from the pages down to the schema.
bullets: Built and maintained database-driven web applications in PHP, MySQL and JavaScript/jQuery for internal teams and outside B2B clients.
Designed and tuned a MySQL schema of 1,000+ tables averaging 700K+ rows each, and set up replication for read scaling.
Refactored legacy code across many files and removed more than 10,000 lines, so it was easier to maintain and faster to run.
Developed, reviewed and tested code on my own for several production applications, working in an Agile team.
Wrote queries and reports against high-volume tables for internal teams and B2B clients.

title: Temple University
bullets: Tutored students in SQL, PHP, HTML and CSS for the Data-Centric Application Development course.
Helped shape a semester workload that students could learn from at a steady pace.

title: Five Below
bullets: Built weekly and monthly labor and overtime reports in Excel that showed store operations where overtime was piling up.
Created sample schedules for test locations and for the holiday season.
Helped organize teams for the rollout of new software.
